content_fields.title: Pin, hash, and continuously audit Python dependencies (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Pin, hash and continuously audit the Python dependency set.
content_fields.finding: Dependencies are unpinned caret ranges with no hash verification and no scheduled audit.

content_fields.required_fix:
# Dockerfile
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --require-hashes -r requirements.txt

# .github/workflows/ci.yml
      - run: poetry lock --check
      - run: poetry export -f requirements.txt --output requirements.txt   # with hashes
      - run: pip-audit -r requirements.txt --strict
criteria: The lock file is committed and CI fails if it is stale.
A scheduled job re-runs the audit against the pinned set.
